evidence.reason: The runbook now calls the controller's refuse_unfinished_transactions guard on an Effects bound to the controller record directory (--record-dir, where deploy-controller.py journals controller-*.json records) immediately before helper.switch and refuses the deployment on any unfinished or malformed record, instead of binding the guard's Effects to the per-run directory that never holds controller records; local tests were not run because the harness permits only git commands, so CI remains the authority.
